5 [F137(1) Section 25 (change from summary trial to committal proceedings) shall be amended
as follows.

(2) In subsections (2) and (6) for the words “may adjourn the hearing without remanding
the accused” there shall be substituted “ shall adjourn the hearing. ”

(3) The following subsection shall be inserted after subsection (7)—
“(8) If the court adjourns the hearing under subsection (2) or (6) above it may (if
it thinks fit) do so without remanding the accused.”]
